title: Motorcycle Chassis — Structural & Modal Analysis
summary: A comparative finite element study of motorcycle chassis behaviour using AISI 1020 and AISI 4140 steels.
card_description: Exploring chassis response and comparing AISI 1020 and AISI 4140 steel through finite element analysis.
overview: The project explores how a motorcycle chassis responds to defined loads and constraints. Structural analysis is used to examine stress and deformation, while modal analysis considers the dynamic characteristics and natural frequencies.
approach: CAD geometry preparation, material assignment, meshing, boundary conditions, static structural analysis and modal analysis using ANSYS Workbench, followed by comparison of the material cases.
takeaway: Explore the documented stress, deformation and frequency results, and consider the importance of modelling assumptions when selecting a material. The two steels produced similar peak stresses in the comparison; one result alone does not determine the best material.

title: V6 Turbocharged Engine — CAD Model
summary: A 3D modelling project examining the geometry and layout of a V6 turbocharged engine.
card_description: Investigating engine geometry and component arrangement through three-dimensional modelling.
overview: This project focuses on representing engine components in three dimensions and understanding how their geometry contributes to an overall engine assembly.
approach: Part-level geometric modelling and assembly-based CAD work, supported by the source models and visual documentation available in the repository.
takeaway: Use the gallery and source files to inspect the component arrangement, model views and available CAD data. The portfolio presents the model as a design exercise, not an experimentally validated engine.

title: Jet Engine — 3D Modelling
summary: A CAD project exploring jet engine geometry, components and assembly representation.
card_description: A jet engine CAD study focused on form, component relationships and assembly representation.
overview: A visual and assembly-oriented modelling study of a jet engine. The project documents the component shapes and the overall arrangement with available engineering views.
approach: Three-dimensional component modelling using PTC Creo, assembly layout and examination of available drawings, models and sectional views.
takeaway: Explore the model images and source files for insights into the engine architecture. This is a CAD modelling exercise rather than a claim of tested propulsion performance.

title: Crankshaft — Failure Analysis
summary: An investigation of crankshaft mechanical response, stress distribution and deformation through engineering analysis.
card_description: Investigating crankshaft behaviour through structural results and the latest technical documentation.
overview: The project studies crankshaft structural behaviour and failure-related considerations based on documented loading, geometry, materials and analysis outputs.
approach: Reviewing the model, imposed conditions and structural outputs. The updated repository documentation is the source for the exact material data, assumptions and numerical results.
takeaway: Open the reports and source files below to examine the documented findings. Avoid interpreting an isolated stress or deformation figure as a complete failure assessment.
